liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (2 other sources): Uploader particularly likes the space segment of this show [2][3]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Desolation Row is beautiful and piano heavy [22]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet is praised, with Vince stepping out; Bob's voice sounds different, perhaps from illness [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer hears great jamming in The Other One, despite the show seeming sloppy and under-rehearsed [13]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Guitar licks traded back and forth in Stella Blue are wonderful [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-01-26.134781.fob.jbraveman.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 176 min [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader describes it as excellent, upfront, with no flaws noted [1]
- **gd1993-01-26.akg.swayne-carls.85934.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 179 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1993-01-26.akg.swayne-carls.85933.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 179 min [3]
- **gd1993-01-26.143219.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 17 songs; 173 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd93-01-26.sbd.miller.26346.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 171 min; rated 3/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard copy has a recording level that is far too high; Soundboard recording is not mixed well, though levels at the show itself were perfect; Reviewer says the soundboard levels are low, if anything [14][18][19][21]
- **gd93-01-26.aud.ladner.21493.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 175 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is poor: very quiet, especially in the second set, and the mix is bad [12]

## Around the show

- A troupe of Chinese acrobats opened; the finale had a girl on a tall unicycle balancing stacked bowls on her head [11]
- Show is strong through Drums, followed by a bonus of Carlos joining in [13]
- First set had technical problems; Bob's voice was off and a friend's brother left during the first song [14]
- Acrobats tumbling all over the place made the night a wild spectacle alongside the concert [16]
- Reviewer says Weir had vocal problems, and a special guest sat in but the second set underwhelmed [17]
- Acrobats and the dragon show made it one of the reviewer's best of almost 30 shows [18]
- Chinese acrobats and a dragon parade during Drums impressed; Weir gave his all with a partial voice, and Santana joined late [21]
- First set is mellow and slow; Bob sounds a little hoarse [22]
- Chinese New Year shows were always a treat, and the 1993 one lived up to that [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-01-26.134781.fob.jbraveman.flac1648**: taped by unknown; transferred by jbraveman; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Unknown FOB AUD > DAT; [1]. Also: Upfront audience recording, transferred from DAT by an archive.org user in December 2015, with few edits in Goldwave [1]
- **gd1993-01-26.akg.swayne-carls.85934.flac1648**: taped by Scott Swayne and Carl S.; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8's (2' spacing on custom T-Bar) > Marantz PMD-700 > (clone) DA-P20 [2]. Also: Taped with AKG mics, down-sampled to 44.1k for CD burning; a 44.1k version was also seeded [2]
- **gd1993-01-26.akg.swayne-carls.85933.flac16**: taped by Scott Swayne and Carl S.; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8's (2' spacing on custom T-Bar) > Marantz PMD-700 > (clone) DA-P20 [3]. Also: Taped with AKG mics, 16-bit; a 48k version was also seeded [3]
- **gd1993-01-26.143219.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Soundboard with patch source from Rob Darroch, John Ammons and Joe Noel; 16-bit 44.1k files [4]
- **gd93-01-26.sbd.miller.26346.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Dat> Cassette Master> Dat> CD> EAC> SHN [5]
- **gd93-01-26.aud.ladner.21493.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [8]
